description: Implementation of the PingPayloadDecoder class for decoding HTTP/2 PING frame payloads, including methods for starting, resuming, and handling decoding status.

classes.name: PingPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for handling the payload of HTTP/2 PING frames, including methods for starting, resuming, and handling decoding status.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the payload of a PING frame, handling the case where the payload is fully in the buffer or needs structure decoding.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding the payload when it was not completed in a previous step.

methods.name: HandleStatus
methods.description: Handles the decoding status, finalizing the decoding process or reporting errors.
